overall.basis: No overall dimension is printed on any plan. W x D TRACED from the main-floor outline (outer wall faces, 703 x 484 px) at 12.0 px/ft, the scale given by the printed room labels (Great Room 26'-7" and 17'-5", Garage 22'-1" and 21'-11", Parlor depth 14'-0", Covered Porch 18'-0" x 12'-0" give 11.9-12.1 px/ft; +/-1.5 %). Closed body = conditioned main floor + enclosed garage: left wall of great room/parlor to garage right wall, garage front to great-room rear wall. Front porch, rear covered porch and the gas-fireplace bump-out on the left wall excluded. Front = bottom of the plans (porch with the foyer entrance and the garage door). Published page figures Width 58' 0" (17.68 m), Depth 39' 10" (12.14 m): their ratio equals the traced bounding box, so they describe the same extent (garage included, rear covered porch excluded), about 1 % smaller than the room-label scale gives. heightM = published Height 29' 0" (no elevation).
